heading: Package → Promote → Discover → Experience.
subhead: Your existing services become events. Audeohost publishes them locally, helps customers discover what's relevant, and keeps them connected once they are at your venue.

moments.title: The menu, the restaurants
moments.text: Sophisticated dining - or casual fare. Promoting your dining as an event gives it a certain level of sophistication in itself. It is an experience, not to be missed.

moments.title: The Hospitality Hub
moments.text:
A great place to relax with friends and equally, to catch the match.
All games have sound. 38% of sports fans say the sounds of sport directly influence how much they enjoy watching. 87% of sports-bar customers stay for the duration of the sporting event.

moments.title: Gym & Pool
moments.text:
Publish the workout and swim schedules.
Customers stay connected even during a high intensity burn!

moments.title: One Group - 4 Grooves!
moments.text: Spin the tunes. Put them through the Audeo-Server. Watch the room flow.

beatStrip: Audeohost-Events are adventures that it was built for — not just sport, and not just a headline event, but a diary of events for customers to plan and prepare for.
